## Summary
- Add 14 tool-calling cases (easy, medium, hard, edge) in `dataset/eval/tool_cases.py`: does the model pick the right tool, with the right arguments?
- Add `dataset/eval/run_tool_eval.py`, which runs each case through the real agent with the tools' backends stubbed (no database or index), scores tool and params, and writes `tool_results.json`.
- Document it in the root README's Evaluation section.

## Test plan
- [x] `uv run ruff check .` and prettier pass
- [x] `uv run pytest -q` (unit suite unchanged)
- [x] `uv run python -m dataset.eval.run_tool_eval` against the live model: 14/14 tool and params correct (billable, needs `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`)
